text:
hana_csm: FYI renewal convo with StellarPay — they want to move from Hosted -> Dedicated mid-term and are asking for a migration credit + enablement seats. Risk: low adoption over last quarter.
raj_sales: how many seats and what credit are they asking for?
hana_csm: asking for 5 enablement seats and a 50% credit on migration setup fee. They're proposing to shorten the term from 12 -> 9 months to align with budget cycle. :thinking_face:
oliver_revops: short term + dedicated migration is tricky for revenue recognition. we'll need a clear billing milestone and vendor code. cc @emma_legal on SOW changes.
emma_legal: please send a draft SOW highlight for the migration scope and acceptance criteria. need to confirm change-of-service clause if term shortened.
matt_eng: from infra side we'll need a 2-week cutover window and a small maintenance window (30–45m) per cluster. estimate: 6–8 engineering hours for migration plan + testing.
hana_csm: customer wants the migration credit tied to adoption — they propose we pay the credit after they hit 60% of target seats active in 6 weeks. thoughts?
raj_sales: we can tie 25% upfront, 75% contingent on adoption. preserves revenue but shows good faith. margin ok?
oliver_revops: that split sounds workable. we need billing lines for PO. sample schedule below for procurement to review:
```
Invoice 1 (upon SOW sign): 25% of migration fee + first month of subscription
Invoice 2 (cutover complete): 25% of migration fee
Invoice 3 (adoption milestone met): remaining 50% credit applied as credit note
```
oliver_revops: also need vendor code and whether they require net30/net45.
hana_csm: procurement wants net45 and a single PO referencing the subscription and migration SOW. vendor code TBD from their side.
emma_legal: we'll add an amendment clause that preserves post-migration SLA and clarifies rollback conditions. small redline and send back.
docu-bot: Document uploaded: "StellarPay_dedicated_SOW_draft_v1.pdf" :page_facing_up:
hana_csm: attaching the adoption dashboard snapshot they sent — usage trending flat, key seats not onboarded. I recommended a 4-week enablement blitz.
matt_eng: enablement plan + migration can run in parallel but recommend we sequence DB cutover after initial training. minimal downtime if staged.
raj_sales: can we offer the 5 enablement seats as part of the renewal (no extra charge) if they commit to 12 seats active in 8 weeks? :thumbsup:
hana_csm: proposed play: 5 free enablement seats + 25% upfront migration fee, 75% contingent on 60% adoption in 6 weeks. If they don't hit targets, credit reverts to invoice.
oliver_revops: I need final dollar amounts and PO flow to approve. also check tax implications for partial credits.
emma_legal: once SOW draft final, I'll prepare an amendment with the adoption milestone language and acceptance tests.
hana_csm: I'll push the SOW to them today and loop in procurement contact (Juniper) for vendor code.
raj_sales: good — i'll prepare a short commercial note for the exec sponsor: high-level benefits + migration timeline.
hana_csm: noting risk flag: adoption < target -> renewal at risk. logging for QBR follow-up. :warning:
oliver_revops: ping me when SOW dollars in, i'll generate the invoice schedule and approval path.
emma_legal: ping when redline accepted, i'll fast-track the amendment.
docu-bot: Reminder: e-sign request queued after SOW approval.
